hero.title: Adana's Future
hero.subtitle: Independent, data-driven urban planning and vision platform
hero.description: Non-political, public-benefit platform offering realistic solutions for Adana's infrastructure, transportation, tourism, and digital transformation needs.

m1Extension.title: M1 Metro Extension
m1Extension.description: North-south metro corridor from Akincilar to ABTU. Connects education and healthcare centers.

ringTram.title: City Center Ring Tram
ringTram.description: Light rail system circling the city center from Central Station. Connects malls, government offices, and tourist spots.

cukurovaRay.title: CukurovaRay Commuter Rail
cukurovaRay.description: Rehabilitation of existing TCDD lines for east-west (Mersin-Adana-Ceyhan) and north (Adana-Kozan) commuter rail.

blueLineExpress.title: Blue Line Coastal Express
blueLineExpress.description: Non-stop service from Adana center to Karatas and Yumurtalik beaches. Starting as express bus, converting to rail on demand.

smartTerminal.title: New Smart Bus Terminal
smartTerminal.description: Modern transfer hub with rail system integration, solar power, and smart traffic management.

tourism.title: Karatas & Yumurtalik Tourism
tourism.description: Karatas: Water sports, eco-tourism, resorts. Yumurtalik: Ayas Ancient City, boutique hotels, gastronomy tourism. Akyatan Lagoon eco-tourism.

agropark.title: Agricultural Specialized Industrial Zone
agropark.description: Value-added agricultural processing facilities in Ceyhan-Yuregir plains. Citrus, cotton, food packaging.

abbAI.title: ABB AI Digital Service Desk
abbAI.description: AI-powered citizen complaint, petition, and request platform. Automatic classification and routing with RAG architecture.

adakart.title: Adakart Smart City Card
adakart.description: NFC and QR-enabled single ticket system. Public transport, parking, and municipal services on one card.

technopark.title: Innovation Technopark
technopark.description: Youth employment, startup ecosystem, university-industry collaboration. Focus on software, agtech, and AI.

waterInfra.title: Water & Drainage Infrastructure
waterInfra.description: Stormwater drainage renewal, reducing water leakage rate, sewage modernization.

greenSpaces.title: Green Spaces & Parks
greenSpaces.description: Seyhan River waterfront landscape transformation, shade corridors, increasing per-capita green space.

bikeNetwork.title: Bicycle & Pedestrian Networks
bikeNetwork.description: City-wide bike lanes, pedestrian-priority zones, bike-sharing system.

disasterPrep.title: Disaster Preparedness
disasterPrep.description: Earthquake master plan, urban renewal, early warning systems, assembly areas.

about.title: About
about.description: This platform aims to present an independent, data-driven, public-benefit vision for Adana's future. It has no affiliation with any political party or movement.
about.missionText: To produce realistic solutions for Adana's chronic problems through engineering discipline and data-driven approaches.

rail.subtitle: {lines} lines, {stations} stations. Metro, light rail, commuter, and tourism express — an integrated urban and regional rail proposal.

budget.heading: Investment in Numbers
budget.subtitle: Distribution of the ~${budget} billion estimated fixed-capital investment across categories. All figures are pre-feasibility estimates.
budget.chartNote: Only projects with a fixed capital-cost estimate are summed. Public-private partnerships and multi-year programme budgets are excluded. Figures are pre-feasibility estimates.

timeline.subtitle: From the first 100 days to year ten — staged, measurable, and implementable planning.

cta.heading: Let's Plan Adana's Future Together
cta.body: This platform is open source. Contribute findings, suggest improvements, or critique — join via GitHub. Every citizen's voice matters.
cta.note: Each project page has a "Share feedback" link; no GitHub account is required to read or propose.
cta.notPolitical: This is not a political campaign. No political affiliation.

projectsPage.heroAlt: Illustration of the Adana skyline and Çukurova delta with a rail-system motif
projectsPage.subtitle: 14 proposed projects for Adana with estimated costs and authority scope. Click any card for the full detail page.

map.title: Adana Vision Map
map.subtitle: Explore rail lines and all project locations on the interactive map. Use filters to view by category.

about.disclaimerText: All projects on this platform are proposals. Estimated costs and timelines are not based on actual feasibility studies. Authority information is provided for general reference only.

footer.notPolitical: This is not a political campaign. No political affiliation.
